name: Townsfolk of Briar Glen
notes: Placeholder for the shopkeepers and villagers of story bible §3.4 ("the townsfolk of Briar Glen"), added with the first shopkeeper, Ottilie Marsh (mw-ju8.9). Friendly to the player from the start, allied with each other and neutral to everyone else, so no townsperson ever picks a fight. Nobody here attacks: a member has no attacks, and a hostile stance would only come from play (theft, violence) once dispositions exist (mw-e22.4). The full story factions and their relations are authored by mw-e13.17 and mw-e40.18, which may replace or extend this entry.
